store.title: Store
store.heading: Level up your community
store.intro: Plans give a community more room and a few perks. Everyone in it benefits, and you can cancel any time.
store.notSetUp: Payments aren't set up on this site yet, so plans can't be bought right now.
store.secure: Payments are handled by Stripe. Magnox never sees your card details.

store.noCommunities: You need a community you manage before you can buy a plan for it.

who.a: Anyone who can manage a community (its owner, or a role with Manage community). The person who pays is the only one who can change or cancel it.

cancel.a: Yes, any time from Plan & billing in the community settings. The plan stays on until the end of the period you paid for.

downgrade.q: What happens when a plan ends?
downgrade.a: The community goes back to Free. Nothing is deleted: anything above the Free limits stays, you just can’t add more until you’re under them again.

switch.q: Can I switch between Plus and Pro, or monthly and yearly?
switch.a: Yes. Changes apply straight away and the price difference is prorated on your next invoice.

pay.a: Checkout is hosted by Stripe, which takes cards and other local payment methods. Invoices and card details are in the Stripe billing portal, linked from Plan & billing.
